name: Christmas Morning Brioche French Toast Bake or Egg, Cheddar & Turkey Sausage Strata
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Home Cooking (Christmas Morning & Thanksgiving Brunch)
whyItWorks: Soaking cubed sourdough or brioche bread overnight in eggs and lactose-free milk with aged sharp cheddar and lean turkey sausage (or cinnamon-vanilla for French toast bake) turns the bread into a soft, soufflé-like custard that digests effortlessly on Christmas morning.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Make with cubed crustless brioche or sourdough bread, eggs, lactose-free milk (Fairlife), aged sharp cheddar, and diced ham or mild turkey sausage (no bell peppers, onions, or spicy pork chorizo).
watchOuts: Avoid adding diced green/red bell peppers, onions, or spicy sage sausage to the strata; skip orange zest in French toast bakes
